A '''Separatist prison camp''' on the [[planet]] [[Jabiim]] was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="ZeroCompany" /> By [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ZeroCompanyDate">{{ZeroCompanyDate}}</ref> three undercover [[Republic Intelligence]] [[Intelligence officer|officers]] were being held in the camp alongside other [[prisoner]]s, with Intelligence [[Lieutenant]] [[Bennic Halloren]] aware of the trio's capture.<ref name="ZeroCompany" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prison camp was mentioned in the optional operation "Escape Jabiim" in the [[2026]] [[Bit Reactor]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]''. If the player chooses to execute the operation, then Halloren contracts the [[mercenary]] outfit [[Zero Company]], with which he is embedded, to rescure the three undercover officers. A team of the mercenaries then infiltrates the camp and quickly identifies the officers, but encounter other prisoners who offer [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to be included in the rescue, while others wish to be rescued but can offer nothing but gratitude.<ref name="ZeroCompany" />

The player has the option of rescuing only the intelligence officers, rescuing the officers and those willing to pay, or trying to rescue everyone in the camp. All three options have a chance of the mercenaries successfully extracting all of the prisoners they attempt to save, with 1500 credits awarded to them for saving those who can pay or everyone. Rescuing only the three undercover officers is always guaranteed to succeed, but if the second or third option are attempted, there is a chance that someone will alert the camp's guards and the alarms will be sounded, resulting in only some of the intended prisoners being rescued, while others are recaptured. Those rescued will always include the three officers.<ref name="ZeroCompany" />
